description.summary: You infuse a target with all the determination and adrenaline of one who is close to death in heated combat, shrouding them in a yellow hue.
description.value: You infuse a target with all the determination and adrenaline of one who is close to death in heated combat, shrouding them in a yellow hue. A target affected by this spell can activate a Limit Break regardless if they are below 50% of their maximum HP. Once a Limit Break has been activated while under the effect of Aura Break the spell ends immediately. A creature cannot benefit from this spell more than once per hour. This spell counters and dispels curse . This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for September 2020 by DeadKingKicker.
